opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; open to Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to postdoctoral researchers for consumables, equipment, training, and other costs to unlock their potential in physiology research.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to develop new educational resources or conduct educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or finalize a project, and to promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, finalize projects, and undertake activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow in their second year of membership or longer; must be a member of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles within physiology.
